description: This Java source file defines the HumanResEvents class, which provides static methods for retrieving and constructing hierarchical data related to human resources, such as employee details, organizational units, and relationships, formatted for use with jsTree in a web application.

classes.name: HumanResEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate hierarchical HR data for UI components.

methods.name: getChildHRCategoryTree
methods.description: Main method to retrieve HR category tree data, including employee details and organizational units, formatted for jsTree.

methods.name: getCurrentEmployeeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of current employee positions and formats them for UI display.

methods.name: getChildComps
methods.description: Retrieves child organizational units or groups related to a given party group.

methods.name: getEmployeeInComp
methods.description: Retrieves employees within a specified organization or party.
